Message.Name: Delete Odd Lot Order Message
Message.Description: The Delete Odd Lot Order message is generated when an existing odd lot order identified by the OrderId is deleted.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading.

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Unique identifier for each order performed within the trading day.

Field.Name: BrokerID
Field.Description: Integer identifier uniquely identifying the Broker.
